# TD Asset Management Inc. Funds Recognized in Eleven Categories at the LSEG Lipper Fund Awards 2026 (Canada)


Published: November 6, 2026


***For the 20th year in a row, certain funds were recognized for providing attractive risk-adjusted returns, relative to industry peers***


TORONTO, November 6, 2026 /CNW/ - A number of investment funds managed by TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM", "we," "our") were recognized at the LSEG Lipper Fund Awards 2026 (Canada), announced on November 6, 2026. This is the 20th year in a row that TDAM funds have received this recognition.


Nine TD Mutual Funds and three TD Exchange-Traded Funds ("TD ETFs") received awards in their respective categories as leading funds.


“We’re honoured to have once again been recognized by the LSEG Lipper Fund Awards,” said Justin Flowerday, CFA, Chief Investment Officer, TD Asset Management and Senior Vice President, TD Bank Group. “This two-decade track record reflects the depth of expertise across our portfolio managers and investment teams and our commitment to consistency across changing market environments. With more than $28.0 billion in assets under management across our TD ETF lineup and C$569 billion in total assets under management1, this recognition comes at an exciting time for our organization and reflects the continued growth and breadth of our investment capabilities. Most importantly, we remain focused on helping clients pursue their financial goals with investment solutions designed to help meet their evolving needs.”


Each of the following investment funds were recognized for providing attractive risk-adjusted returns, relative to industry peers, across one or more performance periods:

The *LSEG Lipper Fund Awards* , granted annually, highlight funds and fund companies that have excelled in delivering consistently strong risk-adjusted performance relative to their peers. The *LSEG Lipper Fund Awards* are based on the *Lipper Leader for Consistent Return* rating, which is an objective, quantitative, risk-adjusted performance measure calculated over 36, 60, and 120 months. The highest 20% of funds in each category are named *Lipper Leaders for Consistent Return (Effective Return)* and receive a rating of 5, the next 20% receive a rating of 4, the middle 20% are rated 3, the next 20% are rated 2 and the lowest 20% are rated 1. The fund with the highest *Lipper Leader for Consistent Return (Effective Return)* value in each eligible classification wins the *LSEG Lipper Fund Award* . For more information, see[lipperfundawards.com](https://lipperfundawards.com/) . **** Although LSEG makes reasonable efforts to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data contained herein, their accuracy is not guaranteed by LSEG Lipper.

**About LSEG Lipper Fund Awards**


For more than 30 years and in over 17 countries worldwide, the highly respected LSEG Lipper Awards have honoured funds and fund management firms that have excelled in providing consistently strong risk-adjusted performance relative to their peers and focus the investment world on top-funds. The merit of the winners is based on entirely objective, quantitative criteria. This coupled with the unmatched depth of fund data, results in a unique level of prestige and ensures the award has lasting value. Renowned fund data and proprietary[methodology](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4022559-1&h=1233847760&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lipperfundawards.com%2FMethodology&a=methodology) is the foundation of this prestigious award qualification, recognizing excellence in fund management. Find out more at[www.lipperfundawards.com](http://www.lipperfundawards.com/) .


**About LSEG Lipper**


With a track record of over 50 years of independent content, LSEG Lipper was the first to develop fund classifications that place funds in their respective peer group. LSEG Lipper data covers more than 380,000+ share classes in over 80 countries. The Lipper Leader ratings are available for mutual funds registered for sale in 47 markets. LSEG Lipper provides independent insight on global collective investments, including mutual funds, retirement funds, hedge funds and fund fees and expenses. LSEG Lipper offers premium-quality data, fund ratings, analytical tools and global commentary through specialized product offerings. Trusted by investment professionals for 50 years, LSEG Lipper provides unparalleled expertise and insight to the funds industry.


**About TD Asset Management**


TD Asset Management (TDAM) is a global asset manager committed to helping clients achieve their investment objectives.1 We are proud to serve institutional, intermediary and individual investors with solutions designed to address their evolving needs. Our specialized expertise and diverse perspectives enable us to navigate changing markets while pursuing long-term outcomes. TDAM offers a broad range of investment capabilities across public and private markets: fundamental equity strategies such as free cash flow-driven approaches, quantitative and passive equities; fixed income mandates across the credit quality spectrum; and alternative offerings such as commodities.
